done.title: Stealth mode with WebDriver detection evasion
Connection pooling with warm browser instances
Request interception for blocking and modification
HAR network capture for session recording
File download handling with download directory and retrieval endpoint
Page interaction actions: click, type, select, hover, waitForSelector
Session timeout with auto-cleanup of idle sessions
Target specific sessions by ID via X-Session-Id header or query param

log.description: Initial engine: launcher.ts, session.ts, cdp-proxy.ts, api.ts (7 endpoints + graceful shutdown)
Implemented POST /v1/scrape: navigate, waitForSelector, extract html/text
Implemented POST /v1/pdf: optional URL, format, landscape, binary response
Implemented GET/POST /v1/cookies: extract and inject cookies
Implemented stealth mode: anti-detection Chrome flags, default enabled
Created Dockerfile + .dockerignore for containerized deployment
Implemented BrowserPool: init/acquire/release/shutdown, ANVIL_POOL_SIZE env
Implemented authenticated proxy: URL parsing, ProxyCredentials, page.authenticate()
Implemented POST /v1/intercept: blockPatterns substring match, enable/disable
Implemented HAR capture: start/stop/get, per-session harStore, page.on('response')

Implemented file download: per-session temp dir, Chrome --download-default-directory, GET /v1/downloads (list) + GET /v1/downloads/:filename (binary stream), path traversal protection, cleanup on destroy. 17 endpoints total.

23 tests for file download: list/retrieve endpoint contracts, path traversal protection (reject .., /, \), URI decoding, download dir lifecycle (create/list/cleanup/stat), BrowserProcess.downloadDir integration, Chrome flag format. 88 total.
feat-file-download: correct path traversal defense (reject + basename), graceful error fallbacks, proper cleanup on destroy, Content-Disposition headers, 23 tests. Approved.
Designed page interaction actions: 5 new endpoints (click, type, select, hover, wait) using withBrowser helper, selector validation, optional params for button/delay/timeout.

Implemented 5 page action endpoints: click (button/clickCount), type (text/delay), select (multi-value), hover, wait (timeout 10s default). All use withBrowser, validate selector, return {success, selector}. 22 endpoints total.

30 tests for page actions: click (selector/button/clickCount/defaults), type (selector/text/delay), select (values array/single/multi), hover (selector), wait (timeout default 10s), shared contract (5 endpoints, error format, withBrowser). 118 total.
feat-page-actions: correct selector validation, safe puppeteer delegation, withBrowser guarantees disconnect, proper defaults, 30 tests. Approved.
Designed API key authentication: ANVIL_API_KEY env var, Bearer token validation, 401 on failure, skip when unset (dev mode), exempt OPTIONS for CORS.
Implemented API key auth: ANVIL_API_KEY env, Bearer token check before route matching, 401 on failure, skip when unset, OPTIONS exempt, startup log shows auth mode.

20 tests for API key auth: env var behavior (empty=disabled, set=enabled), header validation (Bearer format, wrong/missing/partial/correct), 401 response shape, OPTIONS exemption, dev mode passthrough, startup logging, check ordering. 138 total.

feat-api-key-auth: correct exact-match Bearer comparison, no key leakage in logs/responses, OPTIONS exempt, auth before routing, 20 tests. Timing side-channel noted but acceptable for internal use. Approved.
Designed session timeout: ANVIL_SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS env (default 5min), lastActivityAt tracking, 30s cleanup interval, auto-destroy idle sessions, timeout info in health/session responses.

Implemented session timeout: lastActivityAt on Session, touch() on every request, startCleanup()/stopCleanup() with 30s interval, timeout info in GET /v1/sessions (timeoutMs/idleMs/expiresAt) and GET /v1/health (sessionTimeoutMs), ANVIL_SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS env (default 5min).

23 tests for session timeout: lastActivityAt field, touch() method (exists/no-throw on missing), startCleanup (0/negative/positive), stopCleanup (idempotent), env var defaults/overrides, session response shape (timeoutMs/idleMs/expiresAt), health response (sessionTimeoutMs), cleanup interval logic. 161 total.

feat-session-timeout: correct touch/cleanup logic, proper interval management, stopCleanup on shutdown, timeout info in responses, 23 tests. Note: || 300000 prevents env=0 from disabling — minor, non-blocking. Approved.
Designed multi-session targeting: X-Session-Id header or ?sessionId= query param, resolveSession() helper, 404 on missing explicit ID, backward-compat fallback to getActive(), touch targeted session.

Implemented session targeting: resolveSession() helper (X-Session-Id header > ?sessionId param > getActive()), 404 on missing explicit ID vs 400 on no active. Replaced all 18 getActive() calls in endpoints. Touch targets resolved session. Health reports multiSession: true.

19 tests for session targeting: X-Session-Id header resolution, ?sessionId query param, header precedence, fallback to getActive(), 404 vs 400 differentiation, resolveSession result type (discriminated union), 18 endpoints listed, touch on targeted, health multiSession, backward compat. 180 total.

feat-session-targeting: correct priority (header > param > fallback), discriminated union type-safe, no injection risk (UUID Map lookup), 404/400 semantics correct, backward compat preserved, 19 tests. Approved.
